mapper.insert: insert into basket_match_data_dispute (dispute_no, match_id, submission_id, initiator_type, initiator_id, initiator_member_id, initiator_player_id, initiator_team_id, dispute_type, original_value, expected_value, dispute_reason, evidence_file_ids, dispute_status, dispute_deadline_time, create_time, update_time, is_delete) values (#{disputeNo}, #{matchId}, #{submissionId}, #{initiatorType}, #{initiatorId}, #{initiatorMemberId}, #{initiatorPlayerId}, #{initiatorTeamId}, #{disputeType}, #{originalValue}, #{expectedValue}, #{disputeReason}, #{evidenceFileIds}, #{disputeStatus}, #{disputeDeadlineTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{isDelete})
mapper.select: select count(*) from basket_match_data_dispute where match_id = #{matchId} and dispute_status in ('PENDING','PROCESSING') and is_delete = 0
select * from basket_match_data_dispute where match_id = #{matchId} and dispute_status in ('PENDING','PROCESSING') and is_delete = 0 order by create_time desc limit 1

select d.id, d.dispute_no as disputeNo, d.match_id as matchId, m.match_no as matchNo, d.dispute_type as disputeType, d.dispute_status as disputeStatus, d.initiator_type as initiatorType, d.initiator_id as initiatorId, d.initiator_team_id as initiatorTeamId, d.dispute_reason as disputeReason, d.create_time as createTime, d.handle_time as handleTime, d.handle_result as handleResult, d.dispute_deadline_time as disputeDeadlineTime from basket_match_data_dispute d join basket_match m on m.id = d.match_id and m.is_delete = 0 where d.is_delete = 0 and m.season_id = #{seasonId} and d.match_id = #{matchId} and d.dispute_status = #{disputeStatus} and d.dispute_type = #{disputeType} order by d.create_time desc, d.id desc

select id, dispute_no as disputeNo, match_id as matchId, submission_id as submissionId, initiator_type as initiatorType, initiator_id as initiatorId, initiator_member_id as initiatorMemberId, initiator_player_id as initiatorPlayerId, initiator_team_id as initiatorTeamId, dispute_type as disputeType, original_value as originalValue, expected_value as expectedValue, dispute_reason as disputeReason, evidence_file_ids as evidenceFileIds, dispute_status as disputeStatus, dispute_deadline_time as disputeDeadlineTime, processed_by as processedBy, processed_by_name as processedByName, processed_time as processedTime, process_result as processResult, reject_reason as rejectReason, correction_type as correctionType, handler_id as handlerId, handle_time as handleTime, handle_result as handleResult, handle_remark as handleRemark, revision_id as revisionId, create_time as createTime, update_time as updateTime, is_delete as isDelete from basket_match_data_dispute where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
mapper.update: update basket_match_data_dispute set dispute_status = #{toStatus}, handler_id = #{handlerId}, processed_by = #{handlerId}, processed_by_name = #{handlerName}, handle_time = now(), processed_time = now(), handle_result = #{handleResult}, handle_remark = #{handleRemark}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, revision_id = #{revisionId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and dispute_status = #{fromStatus} and is_delete = 0
